text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) was 
packed with spectators. Their eyes were 
set on the clash between the top three 
contenders—the "BNW."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Biwa Hayahide felt the 
same "unease" toward Winning Ticket that 
she had felt toward Narita Taishin during 
the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket's dream was to conquer the 
Derby. Remembering how she had cut herself 
off from others to immerse herself in 
practice for that dream...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Once the race is over, I'll understand 
what this feeling is." Telling herself 
that, Biwa Hayahide stepped up to face the 
race.
